info.title: Rendora API
info.description: PHP 8.2 / SQLite. Amounts use integer EUR cents. All business operations enforce membership and role server-side. Browser: HttpOnly session cookie + CSRF. Native app: POST /auth/login with client=mobile, Bearer opaque token (24h expiry), store in OS secure storage. X-Company-Id is mandatory on tenant routes. Re-authenticate on 401. Dates use Europe/Lisbon for business rules. See docs/API.md for permissions and payment lifecycle.

token.description: Only returned when client=mobile. Store in OS secure storage.
